items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Recipient block moved from baselines 65-80 mm to 54-69 mm (4 lines) so the postcode line stays inside a C5 right-window envelope with A4 folded in half; recipient data unchanged.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No new failure paths; empty recipient fields are skipped (previously only department was), which only matters for empty data that does not exist in MUNICIPALITIES.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Pure layout change; no input handling, network or storage touched.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Two new tests read real line positions from the generated PDF stream (no internal mocks): all four recipient lines inside the 48-72 mm window band (red before the fix: address at 75 mm), and 3-line recipients close the gap.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Mirrors the existing sender-block loop (lines.forEach with index * 5); file stays at 105 LOC.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No I/O boundary; output PDF layout only.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No skip/only/quarantine added; lint, typecheck and full suite (379 tests) green.
